the development of efficient and accurate time-integrators for the LLG and ELLG equation, which are based on the idea of an implicit-explicit (IMEX) scheme.
the development of efficient numerical schemes for the simulation of the LLG and ELLG equation, and we provide a detailed convergence and stability analysis for both methods.
the development of an efficient numerical scheme for the simulation of magnetization dynamics.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a linear second-order IMEX integrator for the Landau-Liftshitz-Gilbrt equation with eddy current approximation.
we propose a new integrator for the ELLG system which is unconditionally stable, formally second-order in time and requires only the computation of two linear systems at every time-step.
we present an efficient and unconditionally convergent numerical scheme for the LLG equation and its coupling with the eddy-current model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ELLG system is a good approximation for the Maxwell-LLG system.
the ELLG equation can be integrated with the same computational costs as the LLG equation.
